async function run(items, operation, config) {
	const width: number = 1;
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	await pool.mapLimit<string>(items, width, operation);
	const concurrency: number = 1;
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript-options
	await mapLimit<string>(items, operation, { concurrency });
	let mutable = 1;
	({ mutable } = config);
	await mapLimit<string>(items, mutable, operation);
	await mapLimit<string>(items, mutable, operation, 1);
	// ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	await mapLimit<string>(items, 1, operation, 4);
}
